title: Install the parameterised half-state patrol (sweeper + workflow pair from objectstack PR #11294)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#11217

Filed by the objectstack skills seat (session `session_01RMTpSRF5CjMmQBFfPtPCwJ`, 2026-08-23) at the ACCEPT of objectstack PR #11294, per the consumer-card duty on that landing. Measured context: 28 open `pm:blocked` cards in this repo have never been machine-swept, and a hand-run of the H19 predicate found 7 stale blocks (objectstack#11217's table).

## What

Once the upstream landing merges, adopt the pair **verbatim**: `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` + `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` from objectstack. Both are parameterised for exactly this: the swept repo resolves `PM_SWEEP_REPO` → `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` → default (a copy running here sweeps THIS repo with its own repo-scoped `GITHUB_TOKEN` — no cross-repo credential), and the anchor issue comes from the repository variable `HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE` with a loud failure when unconfigured (it will NOT silently write into a wrong issue).

## Executable acceptance criterion

A scheduled (or manually fired) run whose summary names THIS repo and writes its findings into this repo's own anchor issue; `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` green at the adopted revision.

## ⚠️ Manual maintainer step (cannot be done by an agent)

Create the anchor issue here and set the repository **variable** `HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE` to its number — repository variables are settings-surface writes. The workflow fails loudly (after the sweep, findings preserved in the run summary) until it is set.

Note: cross-repo `Blocked-by:` targets (e.g. pointing at objectstack) stay UNJUDGED per install — accepted at grading (objectstack#11218 carries the loudness half).

Refs: objectstack-ai/objectstack#11217 · objectstack-ai/objectstack#11196 · PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#11294.
